hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/band-retrieval (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/band-retrieval, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

definition: "Cloud-native windowed read of one Sentinel-2 COG band asset of a STAC item, cropped to the area of interest and reprojected to the requested CRS." -> "Cloud-native windowed read of one Sentinel-2 COG band asset of a STAC item, cropped to the area of interest, whose CRS is given by `epsg`; the output keeps the CRS of the asset." The tool does not reproject: epsg is passed to gdal.Translate as projWinSRS, the CRS of aoi (read, app.py), and the four crop_*.tif of the run record water-bodies stay in EPSG:32610 (observed 2026-11-10). Substantive: it changes what the item means.

processDescription.inherited.json added with the attachment to the Implementation Profile band-retrieval: the deployed processDescription with each bound input and output linked to the role it implements (metadata, role implementation-input or implementation-output) and carrying that role's dataType; the profile schema inherits it. The deployed processDescription is unchanged.
byReference added: the input item implements the role product of band-retrieval as the URL of a STAC Item, not the Item itself (decision C1 of 2026-11-10).
roleDecompositions added: the role areaOfInterest of band-retrieval is taken as the two inputs aoi (four numbers in one string) and epsg (their CRS), neither of which carries its representation.

plan: executionUnit.href moves from GeoLabs/ogc-eo-application-package-hands-on f472585 to 72a76ae, pushed on 2026-11-11 (water-bodies/app-pkg-multiple/crop.cwl). The 72a76ae CWL declares the format of its Files, so the processDescription derived from it changes: contentMediaType application/octet-stream -> image/tiff; application=geotiff (with contentEncoding binary) for the output cropped, in processDescription.json and processDescription.inherited.json. The assumedFormatGaps recorded at the attachment on 2026-11-10 for cropped were removed the same day, when the corrected CWL served these formats; the entry has none.

prefLabel: Crop a Sentinel-2 COG band to an area of interest
definition: Cloud-native windowed read of one Sentinel-2 COG band asset of a STAC item, cropped to the area of interest, whose CRS is given by `epsg`; the output keeps the CRS of the asset.

byReference.name: item
byReference.note: The product is given as the URL of its STAC Item, a string, not as the STAC Item itself.

roleDecompositions.note: The area of interest is taken as one string of four comma-separated numbers (`aoi`) and the identifier of their CRS (`epsg`, passed to gdal.Translate as `projWinSRS`), not as one OGC API - Processes bounding box: the representation bounding-box-ogcapi-processes-bbox of the role is not served.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: load_collection with a spatial_extent (aoi) and a single band selected (filter_bands); the STAC item is given by URL rather than resolved by collection/date/bbox search, and the windowed COG read (no full download) is an implementation detail openEO back-ends make transparently.
